scoring_justification: Result-level comparison against gold paper-reported values; recompute from raw artifact is not feasible in checker sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for E and G at specific configurations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Eq.8 for spherical cases, explicit statement for platelet E=8 GPa, G=3.5 GPa; porous PPF moduli from paper text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper: Fig.2/paragraph gives E at porosity 0.5 and 0.7; Eq.8 gives three-phase spherical moduli; abstract/body states platelet moduli. Dense spherical values linearly interpolated from stated endpoint 2.0 and 2.4 GPa. Tolerances chosen to allow minor numerical differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold values trace directly to reported numbers in the paper.

outputs.description: Effective elastic moduli predictions for the specified configurations.

output_contract.notes: Structural checks include monotonic decrease of E with porosity, monotonic increase with particle concentration, higher E for oblate particles than spherical, and linear fit coefficients for the spherical three-phase case matching within tolerance.

steps.description: Evaluate EPI predictions: quantitative accuracy on key paper-reported E and G values, plus structural trends.
